The recorded treasury amount is 1,310,960. The strongest grounded claim is: The proposal requests 1,310,960 ada, consisting of 1,272,777 ada for Cardano Hardware Wallet Maintenance & Compatibility Assurance and 38,183 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.

A material weak point is that this claim remains proposer-asserted or thinly supported: The proposed scope is limited to maintaining hardware-wallet compatibility, security, supporting libraries and tooling, release support, and vendor-required audit work, and is not intended to build a new wallet product. The blocking questions are: missing complete proposal summary; missing budget analysis; missing feasibility assessment.
